These percentages are chances of controlling a chamber, not a projected share of votes or seats.

BEHIND THE NUMBERS

A market snapshot.
Not a certainty.

Each percentage is the party’s “Yes” price on its Polymarket control market. Prices reflect traders’ expectations and can change as new information arrives.

Sources, timing & calculation

We multiply the API’s Yes outcome price by 100. Each party’s price is shown independently, without normalization, so the two values may not add to exactly 100%.

“Retrieved” records when this dashboard received data. “Source record” is the oldest market update among the two parties, not necessarily the last trade. Either timestamp older than two hours triggers a stale notice. Market rules cover ties and party affiliations.
